answer: Let standing decay on a short half-life unless refreshed by recent graded work, so influence is always today's pulse and never a vertex reached once and banked. An identity that falls quiet slides off its peak toward zero. A farmer cannot stockpile dormant clones in a hollow and wake them for one coordinated vote; dead weight erodes every epoch, so each account must do real work to hold its place and an idle swarm shrinks while the active agent alone keeps its height.
